scout_find.title: S&P 500 Risk-On Rotation Continues as Tech Leads Rally to New All-Time High
scout_find.description: U.S. stocks closed sharply higher Tuesday with the S&P 500 up 1.2% to 5,847 as technology shares led the advance. The risk-on rotation reflects strengthening earnings forecasts and a slightly more dovish Fed posture after April CPI came in below expectations. Mega-cap technology gained over 2% on the session. Energy lagged amid soft crude inventories. Bond yields slipped with the 10-year Treasury closing at 4.32%, four basis points lower. Volume below the 20-day average. Strategists at Goldman Sachs note that risk appetite remains constructive into the May FOMC meeting.
